evidence.quote: At the moment the only supported CRS is Amersfoort / RD New + NAP height (EPSG:7415).

observations.limitation: Format 2.0 is not dataset release; 0.001 m encoded scale is quantization, not a survey error bound. Native artifact still says verticalReferenceState not_interpreted and globalPlacement not_qualified; no artifact is rewritten.

Authority says the name changed on request of Dutch authority, prior name used before February 2026. Same code/components support interpretation of the older issuer label; no new transform or accuracy follows.

evidence.quote: Cartesian 2D CS. Axes: easting, northing (x,y). Orientations: east, north. UoM: m.
Vertical CS. Axis: height (H). Orientation: up. UoM: m.

observations.limitation: Definition supports named-frame interpretation and metre units, not the source realization, coordinate epoch or an independent positional error measurement.

evidence.quote: Maximum elevation on roof surface based on reconstructed 3D model in LoD2.2. Given as elevation above sea level (NAP).

observations.limitation: NAP height is the named vertical coordinate, not an ellipsoidal height. No RDNAPTRANS/grid/geoid version, independent benchmark, epoch or transform residual was supplied or evaluated. Current schema names the generic roof-height field b3_h_max, while retained CityJSON uses b3_h_dak_max; this is named-reference context, not a verified release-specific attribute map.

evidence.locator: date; absence of ETag and Last-Modified headers

evidence.quote: Acquisition year of the point cloud. This is determined by looking at the GPS timestamps on the AHN points for the building. In case good GPS timestamps are not available the file creation date of the point cloud file is used.

documentedReleaseExamples.2024.12.16: Release date 20 December 2024; introduced AHN5 input

observations.limitation: 2024 is a point-cloud acquisition-year attribute with documented fallback, not dataset release, exact survey date or coordinate epoch. BAG administrative dates and HTTP retrieval date have different roles. Current docs/release features cannot bind this unversioned API response to one release or source/software lineage.

evidence.quote: Root Mean Square Error of the 3D distances between the point cloud and the LoD2.2 model. Unit: metre.
attributes are now calculated using all the AHN building points, instead of only roofplane points.

observations.limitation: Source-reported reconstruction-to-input-cloud fit. No independent surveyed checkpoints, signed error/residual vectors, confidence interval, absolute horizontal/vertical error or calibration of systematic bias is supplied. Release-specific all-building-points change is methodology context, not a verified software/version binding for D1.

PREFERRED_AND_LATEST means good coverage and no newer cloud with good coverage in the issuer selection context, not current-as-of-2026 building state. Quality flag true is source-supplied: documentation formula requires overlap == 0 while this field is null, with no null-handling rule shown. Do not recalculate/coerce null to zero. The AHN5 no-data description mistakenly names AHN4; preserve key/value and flag documentation ambiguity. Empty val3dity error-string is source structural indicator, not accuracy; null floors remains null.

evidence.quote: the data positional data accuracy is 30 cm.
The quality attributes that we calculate for and assign to each model provide an indication of this quality.
Improved geometric validity. Now 99.15% of buildings are geometrically valid.

observations.limitation: Neither is an independently measured D1-building positional accuracy. General sources page still describes AHN3/AHN4 and has duplicated AHN4 date wording; retained D1 and newer release notes explicitly use AHN5. Treat it as partially stale methodology, not exact D1 lineage or survey specification.
